answer: Cosignatures are collected in walnut, verified in forge, and quartz names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 23 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
